topography.project_purpose: SmartCredit is a decentralized lending protocol that enables users to borrow and lend assets, with integrated reputation tracking to assess creditworthiness. It uses upgradeable proxy contracts to manage lending logic and a ReputationToken to record user behavior on-chain.
topography.relationship_narrative: The TransparentUpgradeableProxy serves as the main entry point for lending operations, delegating calls to the implementation contract, while the ReputationToken is used to track user credit history across interactions.
